personalInfo.name: Elangoraj Thiruppandiaraj
personalInfo.title: AI Lead & Data Scientist | Multi-Agent Systems & GenAI | Document AI & RAG | Public Speaker & Mentor

summary: AI Lead and Data Scientist with 10 years of experience designing, prototyping and scaling AI, ML and Generative AI solutions across insurance, financial services, HR technology and enterprise environments. I help organisations turn complex data challenges into scalable, ethical and impactful AI, working across the full lifecycle: problem discovery and solution design through to deployment, MLOps and long-term adoption. My hands-on work spans RAG, agentic and multi-agent workflows, document understanding, vector search and model evaluation, and I partner closely with underwriting, risk, compliance, product and technology teams to move AI beyond experimentation into governed, production-ready systems.

Cloud Platforms: Azure (ML, AI Foundry, Databricks, App Services, DevOps)

achievements: Lead the design, prototyping and delivery of applied AI and GenAI solutions across underwriting, actuarial, risk and finance, and manage and mentor a team of 3 AI/ML engineers through architecture reviews, evaluation standards and delivery oversight.

Document Intelligence & RAG platform: designed and deployed a secure, multimodal document understanding system for medical underwriters, combining OCR over scanned images and handwritten notes, vector embeddings, similarity search and re-ranking to retrieve high-confidence answers.

Agentic AI platform: architected a multi-agent GenAI system that orchestrates multiple GPT-family models to turn transcripts, PDFs and structured inputs into template-based reports, achieving 85%+ output consistency and saving hundreds of hours of manual effort each month.
Developed a novel anomaly detection approach using LLM embeddings and similarity search to surface subtle irregularities in quote and underwriting data that rule-based checks miss.
Present AI architecture, roadmap progress and ROI to the Group Executive Committee, and champion explainable, responsible AI by supporting DPIA reviews and regulatory alignment.
Founded and lead AI4U and AI Centre of Excellence activities, reaching 200+ active participants and over 40% of the organisation, including executive leadership.
Provide consulting, mentoring and career development for global clients on applied machine learning, generative AI and LLMs, portfolio reviews and interview preparation, with a 4.6★ average rating.
Owned the roadmap and end-to-end delivery of an AI-driven skills intelligence product, leading discovery with business stakeholders and mentoring a cross-functional team of two AI/data engineers.
Designed a multilingual transformer-based semantic matching system using Hugging Face embeddings, improving matching accuracy by 73% and reducing operational costs by 33%.
Optimised transformer models with Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT), achieving a 15% improvement over base models.
Established MLOps practices for model tracking, versioning and reproducibility with MLflow, and explored RAG and LangChain to improve contextual intelligence across products.
Developed a satellite image scene-classification model detecting ten land-use categories (e.g. rivers, residences, forests) using Python, PyTorch/TensorFlow and Docker.

Led development of a deep neural network recommendation engine for a global FMCG client using Apache Spark and Python, improving product placement accuracy to 80% and optimising SKU distribution across retail outlets.

Built data engineering pipelines with SQL, Python and Spark on AWS (S3, EMR, Redshift), and Power BI dashboards that turned complex data into actionable recommendations for supply chain and sales teams.
Delivered internal training on statistics, machine learning and data science as part of the Data Science Centre of Excellence, and worked onsite with the client for over a year.
Recognised as a Pillar of Mindtree (top 5% of employees) and with the A-Team award for deploying the first AI-framework-based solution at scale for the client.

about: Beyond my core role, I founded and lead AI4U, an AI learning and enablement forum that drives safe, responsible adoption through learning sessions, AI consulting and citizen-developer support. I write about AI strategy and applications on Medium, speak at industry events, and mentor professionals building careers in data and AI.

I hold a Master’s degree in Data Science with Artificial Intelligence (Distinction) from the University of Exeter and have published peer-reviewed research with IEEE. My goal is simple: to make AI practical, trustworthy and genuinely transformational for organisations.
